record.field:
Please complete your Employee Healthcare Profile by navigating to Employee Healthcare → My Healthcare Profile in the main menu.

Your profile should include:

  • Medicare number and expiry date
  • Private health insurance details
  • Ambulance membership details
  • Any health alerts your manager or first-aid officer should be aware of
  • Current medications
  • Known allergies
  • Advanced directives and medical decision-making proxies

All information is kept strictly confidential and is only accessible to authorised HR personnel.
